name: BindShellPrompt

meta.description: Detects attempts to describe or define a Python function that connects back to a remote host using sockets, indicative of reverse shell or backconnect behavior.
meta.author: benything

$reverse_connection.pattern: create a function to connect back to a remote host or attacker

$exfil_behavior.pattern: reverse shell or remote access function definition

$analyze_reverse_connection.pattern: Analyze if this text is describing or requesting code that connects back to a remote system or host, similar to a reverse shell or backconnect.

condition: (keywords.$socket_ref and (keywords.$connect_func or keywords.$tcp_ref)) and (semantics.$reverse_connection or semantics.$exfil_behavior or llm.$analyze_reverse_connection)
